page.layout: Running head at top: "LIB. III. Scutum Regium." with page number 161 at top right. One text column of running text. One marginal note column at the right, beside the text. page.notes: Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and were omitted. Greek word "μεγαλοψυχία" is uncertain and marked. "sti" at the line start is uncertain. The printed "5 o." of the Psalm number is spaced and uncertain. The note "Theodoretus" is hyphenated across lines as "Theodo-/retus" in print; written whole here. The last line ends with "tuti" and the catchword "Imperij" below; "tuti" is marked as uncertain because the scan is faint at the line end.
